message.reasoning_content:
We need to read the fact: "2012年至2014年，被告人王某在担任龙岩市新罗区雁石镇岩星村党支部书记期间，利用职务便利收受龙岩市之州房地产开发综合有限公司法人代表兼董事长郑某甲在建设龙岩市新罗区雁石镇岩星新村过程中给予的人民币470000元。"

This is classic "受贿" (accepting bribes). The role is a party branch secretary (public official). He used his position to accept money from a company representative in exchange for facilitating construction. So the crime is "受贿". Possibly also "行贿" is for the other party, but we only list crimes of the defendant. So only "受贿". No other crimes indicated.

Thus answer: [罪名]受贿<eoa>
